name: pty-exec-bit-heal
summary: Heal node-pty's spawn-helper exec bit before every spawn
body:
npm does not always preserve the execute bit on the prebuilt
spawn-helper; the symptom is posix_spawnp failed and a terminal that
dies on open. chmod it idempotently before spawning — self-healing,
so a reinstall can never bring the bug back. Verified inside a real
Electron process.
